name: Speak with Gramma
summary: This errand sends an adventurer to Gramma Stonefield on behalf of her grandson Tommy Joe. Caught in a bitter feud between the Stonefield and Maclure families, Tommy Joe hopes the elderly matriarch knows a way he can see Maybell Maclure.

sections.title: A Feud and Forbidden Love
sections.body: The Stonefields and the Maclures have spent years locked in bitter agricultural rivalry, turning neighboring homesteads into hostile territory. Caught in the middle are young Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure, whose romance has to be conducted in total secrecy. Desperate for a way to meet his beloved without sparking violence between their kin, Tommy Joe turns to his grandmother for guidance.

sections.title: Gramma's Cunning
sections.body: Though age has kept Gramma Stonefield indoors, she understands the nature of the feud better than anyone. While she recognizes that a true union between the two families is impossible as long as the bad blood persists, she has no intention of letting neighboring grudges crush young love entirely. Instead of urging caution, she begins scheming small opportunities to bring the two together.

faq.q: Why does Tommy Joe want me to speak with his Gramma?
faq.answer: Tommy Joe is deeply in love with Maybell Maclure, but their feuding families make meeting impossible. He believes his grandmother has the wisdom, sympathy, and cunning to help them arrange secret meetings without causing an uproar.

faq.q: Where can Gramma Stonefield be found?
faq.answer: Gramma Stonefield stays inside the main Stonefield farmhouse, located east of the riverbank where Tommy Joe hides, south of Goldshire.

faq.q: What is the feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures?
faq.answer: The two neighboring farming families have a long-standing personal and territorial grudge. Accusations of theft, rivalry over crops, and mutual distrust keep both households on the brink of violence, forcing any interaction between their children underground.

faq.q: Does Gramma Stonefield oppose Tommy Joe's relationship?
faq.answer: No. Although she acknowledges the feud makes a long-term future difficult right now, she has a soft spot for the young lovers and is willing to concoct schemes to help them meet.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Gramma?
faq.answer: Gramma begins formulating a plan to sneak Tommy Joe and Maybell together, sending the adventurer on errands to prepare an invisibility liquor to bypass watchful family eyes.
Maybell is the daughter of the rival Maclure family, living just across the road from the Stonefields. She is secretly courting Tommy Joe Stonefield.

angles.text: For humans adventuring in Elwynn, the Stonefield-Maclure conflict is a reminder of how deeply local grudges run in the heartlands of Stormwind, even in the shadow of broader realm-wide crises.
While Stormwind faces Defias unrest and beast attacks, Alliance travelers often find themselves playing mediator in petty domestic squabbles between neighboring farmers.
